patch_description:
Replace the current 6-param/block design (two separate mid-mixer params ry_mid1, rx_mid2) with a 5-param/block design that uses a single shared "mid" parameter applied as RY at the first CZ break and RX at the second CZ break. This:
1. Reduces params from 38 to 32 (matching the best design), improving regularization and parameter efficiency
2. Maintains 3-stage CZ entanglement (12+8+8 edges) for richer circuit structure
3. Alternates between Y-axis and X-axis mid-mixers for maximal non-commutativity with the diagonal CZ layers
4. Keeps same gate count (540) as the best design
The alternating single-axis approach is more parameter-efficient than dual-axis mid-mixers while still breaking CZ commutation at two circuit points.
